architecture.policy: Explore many structure families, pair each shortlisted kernel with one embedding grammar and one visual system, pause for explicit human selection, then compile exactly one lane. Never concatenate the whole library into one prompt.

asset_preparation_modes.title: Use Transparent Original
asset_preparation_modes.when: A verified transparent source asset with clean alpha is available.

asset_preparation_modes.title: Segment Protected Edge Band
asset_preparation_modes.when: A product or evidence object exists only inside a flattened raster.
asset_preparation_modes.policy: Keep protected core pixels unchanged; modify only the alpha/edge band needed to remove the old background.

asset_preparation_modes.title: Semantic Resynthesis
asset_preparation_modes.when: Creative reconstruction allows semantic identity instead of source-pixel identity.

asset_preparation_modes.title: Framed Source Fallback
asset_preparation_modes.when: No reliable cutout can be produced without damaging evidentiary pixels.
asset_preparation_modes.policy: Explicit degraded fallback only; never disguise a rectangular source crop as seamless embedding.

product.title: Semantic Joint Render
product.description: The model rebuilds the object and surrounding scene as one coordinated visual node; semantic identity is audited, not pixel identity.

product.title: Transparent Flat Embed
product.description: A clean alpha product asset sits directly in the composition with no inherited rectangular background, using shared grain, edge color, and local grounding.

product.title: Grounded Stage Embed
product.description: A clean product cutout is anchored to a shared shelf, shadow, halo, or light pool that belongs to the whole composition.

product.title: Material Tuck Embed
product.description: The object overlaps or tucks into a generated paper, ribbon, contour, or translucent material boundary while its protected core remains untouched.

product.title: Explicit Framed Fallback
product.description: A visibly intentional frame contains a source crop only when seamless extraction is unsafe; it is never the primary recommendation.

text.title: Joint Typography
text.description: The model composes typography with the scene and exact strings are audited or locally repaired.

text.title: Direct on Quiet Field
text.description: Exact type is placed directly on a low-frequency region planned with the node, without a generic rectangular card.

text.title: Material Surface
text.description: Exact type follows a shared paper, glass, ribbon, shelf, or light surface already participating in the composition.

text.title: Editorial Annotation
text.description: Copy is integrated as captions, pull facts, marginalia, or callouts bound to the object rather than boxed as an isolated tile.

text.title: Contour Rail
text.description: Copy follows a path, contour, radial rail, or connector that also carries the reading order.

text.title: Explicit Card Fallback
text.description: A bounded card is used only when text density or contrast makes integrated placement unsafe, with documented reason.

families.title: Flow and Path
families.description: Continuous paths turn discrete nodes into a guided journey.

defaults.description: A continuous directional path that guides semantic nodes through the canvas.

kernels.title: Serpentine Flow
prompt_hints: Use one continuous curved path as the organizing gesture.
Alternate indivisible semantic nodes across the path with deliberate scale changes.
Keep the path legible without turning it into two disguised columns.

kernels.title: Spiral Unfold
prompt_hints: Build a loose spiral that progressively changes node scale and density.
Use one focal core and a clear outer entry point.
Avoid equal rings or a decorative swirl with no reading order.

kernels.title: Zigzag Ribbon
prompt_hints: Use an angular folded ribbon to create decisive directional turns.
Place one semantic node at each major turn and vary the size of turns.
Keep the ribbon structural, not a decorative arrow overlay.

kernels.title: River Confluence
prompt_hints: Group related nodes on separate tributaries that converge on one conclusion.
Use line weight and spacing to distinguish branches.
Do not imply causality or ranking unless the source states it.

families.title: Editorial Hierarchy
families.description: Publication grammar creates hierarchy through leads, columns, pull facts, and captions.

defaults.description: A publication-led composition with asymmetric editorial hierarchy.

kernels.title: Feature Cover Stack
prompt_hints: Open with an oversized editorial lead and one dominant image zone.
Stack secondary nodes with controlled overlaps and uneven rhythm.
Avoid a uniform catalogue or dashboard.

kernels.title: Newspaper Spread
prompt_hints: Turn the content into a lead story with variable-width columns and pull facts.
Use rules and gutters to bind dense copy without repeating cards.
Make one editorial thesis visibly dominant.

kernels.title: Split Feature Dialogue
prompt_hints: Create two intentionally unequal feature fields connected by a bridge element.
Use the second field as counterpoint rather than a mirrored column.
Do not reproduce a fifty-fifty source split.

kernels.title: Annotated Column Essay
prompt_hints: Build a strong main narrative column with annotations living in the margins.
Use callouts as controlled detours that return to the main flow.
Keep annotations visibly attached to their own semantic nodes.

families.title: Modular Comparison
families.description: Modules support dense comparison without defaulting to a uniform grid.

defaults.description: A modular comparison grammar with varied scale, cadence, and grouping.

kernels.title: Catalogue Bands
prompt_hints: Replace cards with variable-height bands and independent data rails.
Alternate crop, density, and scale from band to band.
Preserve each item's data as one semantic node.

kernels.title: Hero Matrix Break
prompt_hints: Use a nonuniform matrix interrupted by one or two spanning hero modules.
Change module proportions and information density by role.
Do not create equal cards or imply ranking through size without a neutral note.

kernels.title: Masonry Clusters
prompt_hints: Form a few distinct masonry islands rather than one full-canvas grid.
Give each cluster its own density and anchor.
Use whitespace channels to establish reading order.

kernels.title: Indexed Lanes
prompt_hints: Organize items on a small number of asymmetrical lanes with a separate index.
Use one cross-lane signal to connect comparable facts.
Keep lanes visually distinct from ordinary columns.

families.title: Radial and Network
families.description: Centrality, orbit, and connection create non-linear comparisons.

defaults.description: A radial or networked composition that organizes supporting nodes around a thesis.

kernels.title: Focal Orbit
prompt_hints: Create one central thesis with a directional orbit of supporting nodes.
Use scale and connectors to make the clockwise route explicit.
Keep dense copy outside the orbit on attached rails.

kernels.title: Constellation Network
prompt_hints: Distribute nodes as a constellation with a few meaningful connections.
Use one anchor and cluster distance to express categories, not false causality.
Avoid random floating dots or a decorative network.

kernels.title: Radial Wedges
prompt_hints: Use unequal radial sectors as content territories.
Let one wedge carry the entry point and another the conclusion.
Do not imply proportional data through wedge size unless verified.

kernels.title: Hub-Spoke Dashboard
prompt_hints: Place a compact summary at the hub and route details along asymmetrical spokes.
Vary spoke length and node scale by editorial role only.
Avoid a generic software dashboard look unless selected by the visual system.

families.title: Spatial Stage
families.description: Objects become exhibits, props, or scenes with controlled depth and separate information rails.

defaults.description: A spatially staged composition with depth, exhibits, and anchored captions.

kernels.title: Museum Exhibit Wall
prompt_hints: Treat semantic items as exhibits on a designed wall.
Use one hero exhibit, smaller satellites, and independent caption rails.
Vary placement while preserving a deliberate guided route.

kernels.title: Scene Shelf
prompt_hints: Stage objects across foreground, middle, and background shelf layers.
Keep exact comparison data on a clear independent rail.
Use coherent light and shadow without redrawing protected inserts.

kernels.title: Isometric Stage
prompt_hints: Use a restrained isometric platform system with one leading stage.
Attach copy to platform edges instead of placing text in perspective.
Avoid game-board clutter and impossible spatial relationships.

kernels.title: Depth Gallery
prompt_hints: Arrange a sequence of frames that recedes through shallow perspective.
Use near, middle, and far emphasis to guide reading.
Keep important text front-facing and legible.

families.title: Typographic and Graphic
families.description: Type, numbers, labels, and graphic fields become the dominant spatial engine.

defaults.description: A typography-led graphic composition with aggressive scale and directional contrast.

kernels.title: Diagonal Zine
prompt_hints: Build an asymmetric diagonal zine with one oversized type field.
Use deliberate crops and layered depth to make a zigzag route.
Avoid polite centered symmetry and equal columns.

kernels.title: Kinetic Type Islands
prompt_hints: Let a few typographic islands define the major spatial masses.
Nest semantic objects beside—not inside—critical letterforms.
Keep exact copy readable; do not distort required strings into illegible shapes.

kernels.title: Number-led Scoreboard
prompt_hints: Use verified numbers as oversized anchors with their own data trails.
Keep every number bound to its product and qualifier.
Do not imply a score, winner, or ranking unless explicitly sourced.

kernels.title: Stamp and Label Field
prompt_hints: Compose a controlled field of stamps, labels, and clipped tags around one hero label.
Use overlap to create hierarchy without hiding exact copy.
Avoid random sticker noise and invented certification marks.

families.title: Tactile and Organic
families.description: Material fragments and organic territories replace rigid containers.

defaults.description: An organic material composition with irregular territories and tactile layering.

kernels.title: Cut-paper Collage
prompt_hints: Rebuild content as a tactile cut-paper collage with controlled irregularity.
Lead with one large fragment and guide attention through smaller cutouts.
Keep labels bound to their own fragments and avoid scrapbook clutter.

kernels.title: Liquid Islands
prompt_hints: Use interlocking fluid territories as large content zones.
Guide reading through narrow negative-space channels.
Avoid generic blobs placed behind an unchanged grid.

kernels.title: Botanical Archipelago
prompt_hints: Create a small archipelago of organic content islands connected by restrained botanical gestures.
Use one island as the entry and vary satellite scale.
Do not imply unsupported natural or health claims through decoration.

kernels.title: Textile Patchwork
prompt_hints: Use variable fabric-like patches with one dominant patch and irregular seams.
Let stitch lines guide reading between semantic nodes.
Keep the result editorial and avoid a uniform quilt grid.

families.title: Diagrammatic and Data
families.description: Maps, trees, blueprints, and spectra turn information relationships into the main layout.

defaults.description: A diagram-led composition where verified relationships determine the spatial system.

kernels.title: Subway Map
prompt_hints: Map categories onto a few transit lines with shared nodes only where relationships are verified.
Use line identity and transfer points to guide reading.
Do not invent sequence, causality, or connections.

kernels.title: Decision Tree
prompt_hints: Start with one explicit question and branch only on verified distinctions.
Make endpoints large enough to hold indivisible semantic nodes.
If no real decision logic exists, use this as a comparison tree without invented recommendations.

kernels.title: Annotated Blueprint
prompt_hints: Use one central object or system with numbered callouts around it.
Keep connector routing clean and exact copy horizontal.
Avoid fabricated specifications, dimensions, or technical claims.

kernels.title: Spectrum Map
prompt_hints: Place semantic nodes along a continuous visual spectrum only when the ordering is source-supported.
Use anchored side notes for details and exceptions.
If the source has no ordered variable, use a neutral thematic spectrum and state that it is non-ranking.

visual_systems.title: Swiss Clinical
prompt_hints: Use disciplined sans-serif hierarchy, crisp rules, cool neutrals, and one restrained accent.
Keep spacing precise without reverting to equal cards.

visual_systems.title: Warm Editorial Paper
prompt_hints: Use warm uncoated paper, ink-like navy and vermilion accents, and restrained print grain.
Let texture support hierarchy rather than blur copy.

visual_systems.title: Premium Dark Metal
prompt_hints: Use deep charcoal surfaces, controlled metallic highlights, and cinematic edge light.
Reserve bright contrast for verified key facts.

visual_systems.title: Playful Pop
prompt_hints: Use high-contrast color blocks, confident rounded shapes, and a limited playful palette.
Keep decorative marks subordinate to semantic nodes.

visual_systems.title: Retro Riso
prompt_hints: Use a two- or three-ink risograph palette, selective halftone, and slight registration character.
Keep exact copy crisp enough to audit.

visual_systems.title: Translucent Glass
prompt_hints: Use restrained translucent layers, luminous color diffusion, and sharp foreground type.
Ensure every text-bearing surface has sufficient contrast.

visual_systems.title: Monochrome Ink
prompt_hints: Use black, off-white, one optional signal color, and expressive but controlled ink marks.
Create hierarchy through weight and negative space.

visual_systems.title: Organic Wellness
prompt_hints: Use muted botanical tones, soft mineral textures, and gentle organic boundaries.
Keep factual claims visually neutral and do not imply medical efficacy.

visual_systems.title: Tech Blueprint
prompt_hints: Use blueprint blue, precise linework, numbered annotations, and restrained glow.
Separate real source facts from decorative technical marks.

visual_systems.title: Museum Neutral
prompt_hints: Use quiet stone and paper neutrals, exhibition-grade spacing, and precise caption labels.
Let object scale and placement provide drama.

visual_systems.title: Neo Brutalist
prompt_hints: Use blunt scale contrast, hard edges, visible structural rules, and a small abrasive palette.
Keep rawness intentional and hierarchy unmistakable.

visual_systems.title: Soft Clay 3D
prompt_hints: Use soft clay-like 3D forms, diffuse light, and tactile depth around semantically preserved objects.
Keep typography flat, sharp, and separate from sculptural forms.
